name: Direct SKU Lookup - Exact Match
input: Need part 00002771
expected_behavior: Should return PUMP (00002771) as Top-1 with high confidence
success_criteria: Top-1 exact match, <1s latency

name: SKU with Description
input: Lead time for RADIATOR 00007068?
expected_behavior: Return 00007068 with lead time information
success_criteria: Correct SKU + lead_time_days field populated

name: Part Description Only - Common Part
input: What's the code for this gasket?
expected_behavior: Return Top-3 GASKET parts with explanations
success_criteria: All Top-3 are GASKET type, with reasoning provided

name: Old Code Lookup
input: Old code 7F-1123, what's the new SKU?
expected_behavior: Search aliases field, return matching SKU
success_criteria: Find part with '7F-1123' in aliases array

name: Part with Specifications
input: Need 5mm M12 bolt for LH517
expected_behavior: Filter BOLTs by specifications and model compatibility
success_criteria: Top results are BOLTs, preferably M12, compatible with LH517

name: Compatibility Query
input: Is 00007068 compatible with model TH663i?
expected_behavior: Check compatibility array for TH663i
success_criteria: Yes/No answer + show compatibility list

name: Replacement Query
input: Replacement for STARTER 00002707?
expected_behavior: Show parts that list 00002707 in replacements OR same type parts
success_criteria: Top results are STARTERs or parts that replace 00002707

name: Multiple Parts in One Query
input: need BC00001432 harness engine + BC00001433 harness hydraulic. available?
expected_behavior: Detect and process both SKUs separately
success_criteria: Return info for both parts with availability status

name: Typos in Message
input: Can I get a replacment for ENGINE 00002463? Its urgant!
expected_behavior: Handle typos gracefully, understand intent
success_criteria: Return 00002463 despite 'replacment' and 'urgant' typos

name: Mixed Language
input: Onko PUMP 00002771 varastossa? need asap
expected_behavior: Understand Finnish + English mixed query
success_criteria: Extract SKU 00002771, understand availability question

name: Vague Description
input: Looking for pump part, maybe for TH663i
expected_behavior: Return Top-3 PUMPs compatible with TH663i with low-medium confidence
success_criteria: Results are PUMPs, explanation mentions model compatibility

name: Obsolete Part Handling
input: Is PLATE 00002897 still available?
expected_behavior: Detect OBSOLETE status, suggest alternatives if available
success_criteria: Inform user part is obsolete (lead_time=-1), offer alternatives

name: Colloquial Language
input: hey quick question - can i substitute 00002671 BOLT with 00008034?
expected_behavior: Understand informal tone, check if both are compatible BOLTs
success_criteria: Compare both parts, provide substitution recommendation

name: Finnish Terminology
input: Tarvitaan PUMPPU 00002771 kiireellä
expected_behavior: Recognize PUMPPU = PUMP, extract SKU, understand urgency
success_criteria: Return 00002771, note urgent request

name: No Clear SKU - Category Search
input: What alternators do we have for underground loaders?
expected_behavior: Find all ALTERNATOR type parts, filter by typical underground loader models
success_criteria: Return ALTERNATORs with model compatibility info

name: Single Word Query
input: pump
expected_behavior: Return Top-5 PUMP parts with note about vague query
success_criteria: All results are PUMPs, warning about specificity

name: SKU Only - No Context
expected_behavior: Direct lookup, return full part details
success_criteria: Return 00002771 with all metadata

name: Non-Inquiry Message (Negative Test)
input: Thanks everyone! Have a great weekend!
expected_behavior: Classify as non-inquiry, no flagging needed
success_criteria: System does NOT flag this as spare-part inquiry

name: Multiple Questions Combined
input: TRANSMISSION 00006117 - is it compatible with TH551 and what's the lead time?
expected_behavior: Answer both: compatibility check + lead time
success_criteria: Return SKU with compatibility list AND lead_time_days

name: Incorrect SKU Format
input: need part BC0000493 or BC00000493?? which is correct
expected_behavior: Try to fuzzy match to BC00000493, suggest correct format
success_criteria: Find closest match, warn about format inconsistency

name: Performance Test - Complex Query
input: Do we have hydraulic cylinders for LH517 front assembly with 50mm bore, preferably in stock next week?
expected_behavior: Parse: category=CYLINDER, model=LH517, spec=50mm, urgency=next week
success_criteria: Return relevant CYLINDERs in <2s, explanation shows understanding of requirements

name: Conversational Context (Tricky)
input: btw anyone checked if the new shipment arrived? talking about the radiators
expected_behavior: Recognize 'radiators' as spare-part inquiry but vague
success_criteria: Flag as inquiry (mentions spare-part), but low confidence on exact part

name: Lead Time Query with Model
input: Lead time for ENGINE DEUTZ BC00004307 for TH430?
expected_behavior: Return lead_time_days for BC00004307, verify TH430 compatibility
success_criteria: Show lead time + compatibility confirmation

name: Finnish with Typo
input: Onko korvike 00012506:lle? MOOTTORI osa
expected_behavior: Finnish for 'replacement', understand despite language
success_criteria: Find replacement parts or same category (MOOTTORI/ENGINE)

name: Quantity Mention
input: 00009363 motor available? Need 2 pieces
expected_behavior: Extract quantity (2), return availability info
success_criteria: Return 00009363 with note about quantity request
